`POST /import` now handles quoted commas, so `"Müller, Hans"` stays in one column. The full suite passes, 84 of 84.

The cause was `src/legacy/csvImport.ts`, which splits every line on `,`. I didn't touch that file, since the Monday sync overwrites `src/legacy/`.
